svg.text: Controlling traffic: ports, IP allowlists, and the WAF layer
source-IP allowlist (VPN / Tailscale CIDR) for admin ports
WAF: OWASP CRS · rate limits · geo/IP · bot control
classic pitfall: a published container port bypasses host firewall
via Docker NAT — always check from OUTSIDE the host

svg.metadata: Created by potrace 1.16, written by Peter Selinger 2001-2019

svg.text: the only point that sees fully
a rejected connection is a log entry, never a silent drop —
drops are what the SIEM correlates

svg.text: Open source: nftables/ufw + Coraza or ModSecurity (OWASP CRS)
AWS: Security Groups / NACLs + AWS WAF & Shield
